title: Is It Rhubarb Yet? season file, version 1
description: Every food and never-food with its UK season as one state per month, January first. Built from _data/foods.yml and _data/never.yml by tools/season-json.js.

schema_version.description: Changes only when a field is removed or its meaning changes; such a change is published at a new path, /season/v<n>.json.

id.description: The food's slug: its page is /<id>/.

aliases.description: Other names the food is asked for by. Each belongs to one food.

glasshouse.description: True when one of the food's rings is grown under glass. A month supplied only from glass reads from_store.

never.description: True for a food never in season in the UK; every month reads never.

months.description: January to December. coming_in: a few about before the season proper, a lull between two seasons included. great_now: in season. going_out: a few about after it, or a few about with no season proper either side. from_store: only from storage or under glass. out: none. never: never in season here.
